title: An LLM-as-a-judge Approach for Scalable Gender-Neutral Translation Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting large language models (LLMs) to act as judges evaluating the gender neutrality of machine-translated texts (English to Italian, Spanish, and German). The methodology tests both target-only and source-target evaluation scenarios, utilizing zero-shot and chain-of-thought (phrase-level annotations before sentence-level judgments) prompting on the mGeNTE dataset to detect unnecessary defaulting to gender-specific terms.
